purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche N benchmark authored only after r24 production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded; it was not used to construct r24.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production verification of r24 and was not used to construct r24.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: replacement gambit doesn't reopen old response window, right?
expectedSourceGroups: Replacing a card does not reopen an earlier timing window

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. Replacing the Gambit does not reopen an earlier timing window.

cases.question: gunboat refused = faceup extra gambit, doesn't use my gambit limit?
expectedSourceGroups: Set this card face up as an additional Gambit
does not count against your Gambit limit

cases.question: safe conduct after refused terms turns my loss into withdrawal?
expectedSourceGroups: discard this card to withdraw instead

cases.question: embargo knocks their asset limit down 1, floor zero?
expectedSourceGroups: Asset limit is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0

cases.question: liquidation treasury card -> capital equal value, then immediate deed buy?
expectedSourceGroups: Gain Capital equal to its value, then you may immediately buy or buy out one Deed

spectral surveillance can go grave instead of intel and reveal all gambits OR all tactics?

cases.question: rite started through nature's altar can finish same turn if i still control it at completion?
expectedSourceGroups: A Rite begun this way may complete this turn if you control this Territory

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, when its completion condition and timing are satisfied.

cases.question: confession picked their gambit in hand. if they set one this turn, they have to set that card if able?
expectedSourceGroups: if they set a Gambit, they must set that card if able

cases.question: retribution fires and they have no assets. +2 conviction?
expectedSourceGroups: If they have no Assets, +2 Conviction

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, if you discard Retribution after they lose a battle they initiated.

cases.question: enter difficult terrain = movement ends and no card action in denouement that turn?
expectedSourceGroups: cannot play a card for its Action effect during Denouement

cases.question: pathfinders shut off difficult terrain during my movement, so entering it doesn't end movement?
expectedSourceGroups: printed effect is inactive during your movement this turn
When a player enters Difficult Terrain, their movement ends

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. With Difficult Terrain's printed effect inactive during your movement, its movement-ending effect does not stop you.

cases.question: attacking fortified pass, my assets are inactive. can't use banked subversion there?
expectedSourceGroups: When an opposing Asset's effect would apply

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. The attacking player's banked Subversion Asset effect is inactive while Fortified Pass's suppression applies.
